Purpose: Classify communities within flood-influence zone of rivers
Rationale: 500m represents typical annual flood inundation corridor for medium rivers in humid Nigeria; must be validated against observed flood extents
Notes: Review after flood hazard model (G24) is built; adjust if observed flood extents differ

Purpose: Flag infrastructure at direct river-bank erosion/flood risk
Rationale: 200m captures high-risk riparian zone; based on documented bank erosion rates in SE Nigeria
Notes: Cross-check against G26 erosion site distances

Purpose: Identify infrastructure threatened by active erosion
Rationale: 100m buffer around active gully heads and margins; based on observed expansion rates of 5-20m/year over 5-year planning horizon
Notes: Apply only to sites with Activity_Status = Active

Purpose: Define communities potentially dependent on or affected by hydropower facility
Rationale: 10km represents approximate service/impact radius for rural mini-hydro and medium hydro in study area; to be reviewed per facility
Notes: Larger facilities may warrant larger buffer; document per facility

Rationale: 2km walking distance approximation for rural service access
Notes: Use point-in-polygon (LGA/community boundary) as primary rule; buffer as secondary

Purpose: Define area represented by each climate station
Rationale: 50km Thiessen/Voronoi zone in data-sparse regions; to be replaced by interpolated surface where station density permits
Notes: Review when full station inventory is complete

Feature: Erosion site to river sediment pathway
Purpose: Flag erosion sites contributing sediment directly to rivers
Rationale: 300m captures likely sediment transport distance for active gullies in moderate-slope terrain
Notes: Combine with slope and flow direction analysis

Feature: Waste dump site — primary exposure zone
Purpose: Direct exposure zone for leachate and air quality impacts from waste sites
Rationale: 500m represents typical documented leachate migration distance and odour/particulate exposure radius for open dumps in West Africa; cross-validated against WHO waste site guidelines
Notes: Apply to active sites only (Activity_Status=Active); WST03 medical and WST04 chemical sites trigger HIGH_WASTE_HAZARD flag within this zone regardless of buffer

Feature: Waste dump site — secondary leachate zone
Purpose: Secondary groundwater and surface water contamination risk zone
Rationale: 1500m extends primary buffer to capture subsurface leachate migration along topographic flow paths; supported by hydrogeological literature for unengineered dumps in alluvial and lateritic soils common in southern Nigeria
Notes: Apply topographic flow direction (G13) to refine actual leachate pathway within this buffer

Purpose: Zone for assessing riparian forest condition alongside river networks
Rationale: 200m (both banks = 400m total) captures the functional riparian zone for most rivers in the study area — sufficient to assess bank stabilisation and water quality functions; recommended by FAO for tropical riparian assessment
Notes: Apply to both banks of G05 river network; larger rivers (Strahler order >= 4) may warrant wider buffer — document per reach

Feature: Protected area buffer — community PA access zone
Purpose: Identify communities that access or are adjacent to protected areas
Rationale: 5km walking distance represents typical daily resource collection radius for rural communities in southern Nigeria; communities within this zone are directly affected by PA management decisions

Purpose: Identify forest edge habitat more vulnerable to degradation
Rationale: 500m from forest boundary where edge effects (increased desiccation; invasive species; hunting pressure) are most pronounced in West African tropical forest fragments
Notes: Apply to G52 current forest boundary polygons
